claims.evidence: Witness photos show a gearbox/transfer-case-like assembly with bellhousing area exposed and internal gears visible, but no readable make/model/part number is captured.
Witness notes missing/unknown: whether it is complete (all sensors, bolts, covers, and internal parts present) is not shown.

claims.claim: Discount if you're ready to buy
claims.evidence: This is a pricing negotiation statement; no photo evidence.

risks.risk: Wrong identification/compatibility (M272 may not match the actual unit shown).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox/transfer-case ID plate or stamped part number, plus the vehicle VIN/engine code it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used gearbox/transfer-case assembly with unknown compatibility.

risks.risk: Not complete or missing critical components (sensors, covers, bolts, linkage, seals).
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing the entire assembly from all sides, including mounting flanges, sensor ports, linkage/hoses/brackets, and any loose/removed parts laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing parts).

risks.risk: Internal wear or damage not visible from surface shots (gear tooth wear, bearing play, shaft endplay).
risks.proof: Video/clip of manual rotation of shafts/gears (showing smoothness), and a teardown/inspection report or close-ups of gear teeth and bearing condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/defective internally (worst-case: needs rebuild).

risks.risk: Oil leaks or seal/gasket failure (seepage may not be obvious in photos).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the unit after cleaning plus underside inspection for wetness, and confirmation of whether it was stored with oil residue; include any leak test results if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unknown leak status (worst-case: may leak).

risks.risk: Operational failure risk (no shift/engagement test; noise/vibration unknown).
risks.proof: A short running test video showing engagement/shift behavior (or a bench test report).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the ID plate/stamped part number (and any label) on the gearbox/transfer-case housing.
Photos of every mounting flange and all sensor/port areas to confirm completeness (no missing covers/bolts/sensors).
Video showing manual rotation of the input/output shafts and any visible linkage movement (smoothness, no grinding).
Photos after wiping/cleaning to check for fresh oil seepage; show underside and seal areas.
Any compatibility proof: vehicle make/model/year and engine code it came from (or VIN).
If possible, a short bench/run test video demonstrating engagement/shift behavior.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a gearbox/transfer-case assembly with bellhousing and internal components visible, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an unidentified, untested used unit. Seller claims about 'M272' and completeness are not verifiable from the provided evidence, so the price should reflect that uncertainty.
